candidates.title_or_work_label: MALLKUANKA—Vuelo Surnorte De Colores / The South-North Flight of Colors
candidates.street_address_or_precise_public_locatio: Conflicting source labels: Mural Arts says Washington Avenue and S. 26th Street; University of Pennsylvania says 2100 Washington Avenue.
candidates.artist_evidence_note: Mural Arts and the University of Pennsylvania Center for Latin American and Latinx Studies independently identify Roberto Mamani Mamani and describe the work's Bolivian/Andean context.
candidates.location_evidence_note: Mural Arts supplies a map coordinate (39.93929433344639, -75.17863328022102), while the University of Pennsylvania says 2100 Washington Avenue. Geocoding that public address yields a point 30.98 m from the Mural Arts coordinate, but the incompatible street-label wording has not been resolved by a source.
candidates.community_context_display: Aymara Bolivian artist; Aymara Indigenous descent; Andean cosmovision; University of Pennsylvania Center for Latin American and Latinx Studies project partner
candidates.community_context_evidence_note: The University of Pennsylvania Center for Latin American and Latinx Studies describes Mamani Mamani as an Aymara Bolivian artist of Aymara Indigenous descent and documents Andean cosmovision. No generic Hispanic/Latine tag is assigned because the source does not explicitly make that identity claim; the source's Bolivian and Aymara wording is preserved.
candidates.before_after_change_note: Before: one Tier 2 Mural Arts source. After: an independent University of Pennsylvania institutional source corroborates artist and cultural context, but it gives 2100 Washington Avenue while Mural Arts labels Washington Avenue and S. 26th Street. Final pin removed until the location label is reconciled.
candidates.missing_evidence_reason: Resolve the conflicting source location labels through an artist, commissioner, property, or institutional confirmation before assigning a final public pin.
